description: Fetch full metadata for a single Dailymotion video by URL (dailymotion.com/video/{id}) or ID: title, description, duration, publish time, view/like counts, tags, topic channel, language, thumbnail, and uploader (whose ID feeds dailymotion/get-user). Uses the public API, which covers everything the video page shows. --include_comments true fetches comments via an API-only endpoint (the site has no comment UI; most videos have none — an empty list is normal). --include_subtitles true returns subtitle tracks. No login or browser required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Video URL (https://www.dailymotion.com/video/xaxueoe) or just the ID (xaxueoe). IDs come from any dailymotion list/search result or the video page URL. 视频 URL 或 ID，可从任何列表/搜索结果或视频页 URL 获得。

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also fetch comments (API-only data; the website shows no comment section). Default false. Most videos have zero comments — empty is normal, not an error. 是否抓评论——这是 API 独有数据，网站本身没有评论区；多数视频评论为空，空列表是常态。

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum comments to return (1-100, default 20). Only used when include_comments is true. 评论条数上限，仅开启时生效。

parameters.name: include_subtitles
parameters.description: Set to true to also return subtitle tracks (language + URL). Default false; most videos have none. 是否返回字幕轨道（语言+地址）；多数视频无字幕。
